easy.statement_latex: Eliminate the parameter $t$ and express the curve $\begin{cases} x = t + 4 \\ y = t^{2} + 5 \end{cases}$ as a Cartesian equation in $x$ and $y$.
hints: Solve one of the equations (usually the simpler one) for $t$, then substitute into the other.
After substitution you should have only $x$ and $y$ remaining. Simplify to standard form.

That is already in Cartesian form: $y = \left(x - 4\right)^{2} + 5$.
